subject: RE: 00211484 — narrowed request — commemorative tree, Church View Close / Great House Farm  New Request 00211722
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Requester

We are writing in respect of below, which you notified us of earlier this month and asked for it to be considered as part of 00211484 and 00211483.  Given the timing of this further request and the detail within we believe that this will in fact need to be treated as an additional request.  We have logged it as such.  The reference number for this request:- 00211722.

We are of the view that this request sits within the environmental information regulation regime.  This supplement was received on 18th October 2026.
Due to the complexity and volume of the information requested, the Council is extending the time available to respond under Regulation 7 of the EIR. Regulation 7 permits a public authority to extend the normal 20 working day response period to a maximum of 40 working days where the complexity and volume of the information requested makes it impracticable to respond within the standard timeframe. The Council therefore expects to provide a substantive response by 14th December 2026.  This extension is necessary because your request requires detailed searches across a range of records and consideration of a substantial volume of historic information before a response can be issued.
We will continue to process your request as promptly as possible and will provide a response before the revised deadline wherever practicable.
Regards

Information Governance Officer/ / Swyd
